parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:

- If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 10.
- If the specified value is greater than 100, the default value is 100.

parameters.name: MetricSetIds
parameters.description: The list of diagnostic metric set IDs.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the diagnostic metric set. Valid values:

- User: user.
- Common: common.

Default value: User.
